samples.title: Round desk: Proof strip
samples.statement:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
readings is a list of integers (numbers with no decimal part). It may be empty, and numbers may repeat unless Step 1 says otherwise. k is a whole number. Use it as described in the steps below.

Step 1: Build the result list
Each number in readings is the work time needed by a job. All jobs are ready at time 0, in input order. The worker gives the first job up to k time units. If it still needs work, put it at the back of the line. Then serve the next job. Record when each job finishes, measured from time 0. Return these finish times in original job order. A job needing 0 time finishes at time 0 and uses no worker time.

Step 2: Return the answer
Return the whole result list in the order you built it. If it is empty, return [].

Write your function
Complete roundDeskProofStrip(readings, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
